leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement an Error Boundary component using class syntax
Configure the Error Boundary to catch errors in its child component tree
Render fallback UI when errors are caught by the Error Boundary
Initialize state to track error status within the Error Boundary
Apply the Error Boundary to wrap components that may throw errors
Manipulate component hierarchy to isolate error-prone sections
Update existing React applications with Error Boundary protection
